questions.prompt: A text says a parcel will be destroyed unless a fee is paid through an unfamiliar link. What should happen?

options.a: Pay the fee within the demanded countdown
options.b: Share a payment-card photo to prove identity
options.c: Check the shipment independently through the verified courier website or app

questions.feedback: Suspicious urgency and links should be verified through trusted channels, not interacted with directly.

questions.prompt: A student receives a scholarship acceptance email from an unknown sender asking for a login password. What should happen?

options.a: Forward the suspected phishing URL to all classmates
options.b: Open the official scholarship portal from a verified bookmark and assess the notice
options.c: Enter the account password through the received link

questions.feedback: Suspicious urgency and links should be verified through trusted channels, not interacted with directly.

questions.prompt: An employee receives an MFA approval push while not trying to log in. What is safest?

options.a: Send a recovery code to a coworker
options.b: Decline the prompt and review account sessions through official security settings
options.c: Approve the prompt to stop notifications

questions.feedback: Unexpected authentication approvals and one-time codes must not be shared or approved.

questions.prompt: A caller claiming to be technical support asks for a one-time code. Which response is correct?

options.a: Refuse to share the code and contact support through a verified channel
options.b: Give the caller the code if they know your full name
options.c: Disable MFA to make support faster

questions.feedback: Unexpected authentication approvals and one-time codes must not be shared or approved.

questions.prompt: A volunteer shift sheet is set to "anyone with link can edit." What is the suitable fix?

options.a: Restrict edit rights to designated volunteers and review prior exposure
options.b: Leave it public because the URL is hard to remember
options.c: Copy all contact numbers into the document for convenience

questions.feedback: Least privilege and deliberate access review reduce unintended disclosure.

questions.prompt: A flashlight app on a trainee's phone requests unrestricted access to contacts. What should the trainee do?

options.a: Grant access because installation already succeeded
options.b: Upload the address book to the app support website
options.c: Refuse unrelated permissions and consider a safer app

questions.feedback: Least privilege and deliberate access review reduce unintended disclosure.

questions.prompt: An email account sends messages the owner did not write. Which response is best?

options.a: Ignore the messages until someone complains
options.b: Pay an unknown recovery agent for remote access
options.c: Use verified security settings to revoke sessions and check recovery and forwarding rules

questions.feedback: Incident handling must contain access, preserve evidence and rely on verified recovery.

questions.prompt: A work tablet with signed-in services goes missing after a fictional community event. What is the appropriate response?

options.a: Share current account passwords with all event volunteers
options.b: Revoke device sessions, protect account access and document possible exposure
options.c: Assume device lock means no response is needed

questions.feedback: Incident handling must contain access, preserve evidence and rely on verified recovery.
